scope: Existing epoch300 checkpoints, complete per-step histories and full validation logs; no training or parameter updates

interpretation.supported: Restoring all-valid-GT classifier learning with matched-only descriptor gradients improves the completed run over matched-only supervision; original all-GT ROI remains the preferred performance version.
interpretation.gradient_path: Unmatched detached descriptors still update the shared auxiliary classifier, changing later gradients received by matched descriptors. No direct unmatched descriptor gradient is required for this indirect path.
not_identified: AP differences are not additive causal fractions of classifier and feature contributions.
The 0.1 COCO AP difference from original ROI is too small and single-seed to establish that unmatched direct feature gradients are necessary.
Auxiliary classification accuracy is not a proxy for detection AP.
interpretation.next_recommendation: End matched-mask ablations. First test original all-GT ROI on the already trained four-site SCDown P3 structural baseline; if useful, prioritize a paired baseline/module transfer experiment on another dataset or backbone.
